tldr: The Sun in Sagittarius: identity built through truth, freedom, and lived wisdom.
body: With the Sun in Sagittarius, the core self strengthens through exploration, study, candor, and the search for meaning. You are here to keep widening the view while embodying what you claim to believe.
gift: Optimism, teaching, humor, honesty, and faith in possibility.
challenge: Restlessness, exaggeration, and using philosophy to avoid accountability.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
